mapper.sql: pi.id, pi.instance_code, pi.plan_name, pi.template_id, pi.warning_event_id, pi.status, pi.source, pi.generated_by, pi.suggestion, pi.escalation_level, pi.start_time, pi.end_time, pi.created_at, pi.updated_at, pi.deleted
mapper.select: SELECT , pt.template_name, pt.scenario_type FROM plan_instance pi LEFT JOIN plan_template pt ON pt.id = pi.template_id AND pt.deleted = 0 WHERE pi.deleted = 0 AND pi.id = #{id}
SELECT status AS group_key, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM plan_task WHERE deleted = 0 AND instance_id = #{instanceId} GROUP BY status ORDER BY status
